text:
maya: Heads-up — tonight's playbook run sent duplicate onboarding nudges to ~60 accounts. We got AM DMs. Looks like the dedupe window didn't apply during retry.

liam: Confirmed. runner log shows: `retry_mode=exponential dedupe_window=0` for jobs retried after a transient db timeout. Expected dedupe_window=48h.

cs-bot: playbook-run 2951122334 failed_step=notify_send attempt=2 flagged=63 emails_sent=126 (:exclamation:)

ruth: Oof. That explains doubled emails. How did dedupe_window become 0?

otis: The scheduler backfill task `pb-schedule/backfill-2026-07` used an older runner binary (v0.9.2) without the dedupe arg default. New binary (v0.9.5) sets 48h default. Backfill explicitly invoked runner without flags.

kevin (eng): I pushed a hotfix to the scheduler: PR https://git.redwood/s/scheduler/pull/178 — enforces `--dedupe-window=48h` on all invocations and adds a unit test. Will stage deploy now.

zoe: Can we also add a safety in the notification runner: if attempt > 1 then apply dedupe_window = max(config, 24h) as a hard minimum? That would prevent accidental zero.

liam: Good call. I'll add that guard. Quick patch: https://git.redwood/s/cs/playbook/+/2421 — small change in `notify.py` line ~212.

maya: For remediation, we should: 1) identify impacted accounts and mark the second email as duplicate in CRM 2) pause outbound playbook runs 3) notify AMs with a template apology and next steps.

kevin (eng): I've staged the scheduler patch; deploying to canary group now.

cs-bot: scheduler-deploy canary started by kevin at 21:12 UTC

otis: I exported impacted list: `SELECT acct_id, email, notify_ts FROM playbook_runs WHERE run_id=2951122334 AND notify_count>1` -> s3://redwood-cs/incidents/2951122334/duplicates.csv

zoe: Thanks. Maya please use the template in docs (cs/templates/duplicate_nudge.md) and add account list. I'll automate CRM flagging with a tiny script:

```
python tools/flag_duplicates.py --input s3://redwood-cs/incidents/2951122334/duplicates.csv --flag duplicate_nudge
```

ruth: Also: let's add an alert rule to detect sudden per-run notify_rate > baseline*1.5 to catch this earlier. I'll open an alert PR.

liam: I've landed the runner guard patch and bumped the image tag to canary. CI green.

kevin (eng): Scheduler canary looks good. Rolling to 20% in staging now.

maya: Paused scheduled playbooks until canary finishes. ETA ~30m. I'll draft AM note and slack post.

cs-bot: playbook-schedule paused by maya until 2951123200

zoe: After this, proposal: 1) hygiene: require runner-version check in backfill jobs 2) tooling: add a per-run dedupe sanity metric 3) playbook: expose dedupe_window in UI so CS can adjust without code.

maya: Agree. Also add a postmortem checklist item: confirm no PII was sent twice per user and list AM outreach done.

kevin (eng): Rolling out full scheduler fix now. Will follow up with deploy link and changelog.

liam: Will also add an integration test that simulates transient db timeout + retry path to ensure dedupe_window is respected.

maya: Thank you team. Once AM note is out I'll ping execs. Appreciate fast responses :heart:
